title: HostCapabilities
description: Abstract runtime capabilities matrix decoupling agent orchestration from host platform names.

has_subagent_dispatch.description: Whether the host can spawn nested autonomous subagents.

has_filesystem_write.description: Whether the host provides workspace file creation and editing tools.

has_terminal_execution.description: Whether the host allows shell command execution in the workspace.

has_mcp_client.description: Whether the host runtime supports Model Context Protocol tool routing.

has_background_tasks.description: Whether the host can launch and monitor long-running background tasks.

max_token_context.description: Token window ceiling supported by the client runtime.
